headword: {共同|きょうどう}{浴場|よくじょう}
reading: きょうどうよくじょう
gloss: communal bathhouse (esp. in a hot-spring town)

definitions.gloss: communal bathhouse (especially in a hot-spring town)
definitions.explanation: A bath shared by a community, especially the hot-spring baths that residents of an onsen town keep up and open to locals and visitors for a small fee.

examples.japanese: {共同|きょうどう}{浴場|よくじょう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{入|はい}った→入る：00494_hairu⟧。
examples.english: I bathed at the communal bathhouse.

examples.english: This communal bathhouse is run by local residents.
